A Wednesday arrival gives better setup time, while the return could be Friday evening, Saturday morning, or Saturday afternoon. The hospital-rate hotel is closest but has uneven reviews and unclear in-room fridge details; a better-rated suite property 15 minutes away confirms queen bedding, coffee maker, mini-fridge, fitness room, and indoor pool but no hot tub and a parking fee.

Rideshare costs now look similar to a compact rental, but a rental would make the hospital commute and grocery stop easier.

events.scenario_brief: After the Baltimore training, Kara receives the schedule for an October pediatric rehab summit in Indianapolis where she has a Friday breakout and a Saturday lab. The official conference hotel block closes soon and has the easiest walk to the meeting rooms, but standard room listings do not clearly confirm mini-fridges and the fitness area is small. A nearby suite hotel has stronger room details with queen studio availability, coffee maker, mini-fridge, and fitness access, but no pool or hot tub and a longer walk or short rideshare. Thursday arrival is needed for presenter check-in, while Sunday afternoon return options are workable if the Saturday lab teardown does not spill over into evening networking plans.
